label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) - Article 29: Processing under the authority of the controller or processor
The processor and any person acting under the authority of the controller or of the processor, who has access to personal data, shall not process those data except on instructions from the controller, unless required to do so by Union or Member State law.
raw_output: When a business sends customer data to a third-party service provider, the provider can only handle that data as instructed by the company, unless required by law. This applies when the company is the data controller and the provider is acting on their behalf.
enrichment: When a business sends customer data to a third-party service provider, the provider can only handle that data as instructed by the company, unless required by law. This applies when the company is the data controller and the provider is acting on their behalf.
